baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence at 47:27 word indices 3-7 joins taking in death to angelic agency and simultaneous blows on faces and backs.
baseline_models.mechanism: A terminal seizure is enacted by direct impact across front and rear. The opposed body surfaces remove both protected frontage and an avenue of retreat, making death an inescapable bodily enclosure.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the taking of a soul in death and sets the terminal frame for the mechanism.
Identifies the agents as angels and assigns the blows to the same plural actors.
Supplies direct impact of one thing upon another as the physical action.
Supplies the visible front of the body as the first pole of the enclosure.
Supplies the rear or back as the opposed bodily pole, completing front-to-back coverage.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely reports death followed by punishment.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages death itself as a coercive seizure whose front-and-rear impacts leave no bodily orientation outside the event.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The taking verb, the directional range of face, and the end-oriented range of back permit a second reading of the same focus construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Taking in full and arriving at an appointment combine with a facing direction and a trailing end. The blows then punctuate not only a body but a completed course, from chosen orientation to its final consequence.

activation_trace.role: Supplies completion without deficiency and makes the taking read as collection in full.

Supplies the last part and passing consequence as the terminal pole of the course.
Supplies attention to what an affair becomes, turning the rearward pole into an evaluated outcome.
Supplies forceful impact as the terminal punctuation imposed on the completed trajectory.

changed_reading.before: Faces and backs are only two anatomical targets.
changed_reading.after: The same pair can bracket a person's directed course and its trailing consequence, both gathered at death without remainder.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: One plural striking verb governs faces and backs, allowing their bodily opposition to activate social presentation and reversal while remaining anchored in the two nouns.
baseline_models.mechanism: The visible or honored face presents a self, while the back can enact turning away; the two-sided face branch makes a divided presentation especially live. A representational branch of striking allows the death scene to expose that split rather than merely injure two surfaces.

changed_reading.before: The opposed surfaces merely intensify the violence.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, death forces a presented self and its contrary turned-away self into one exposed field of impact.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ordered recurrence moves from considering an affair's outcome, through retreat on the backs after clarity and guidance, to backs receiving the angelic blow. The rear target therefore becomes the embodied direction of a prior reversal, not an arbitrary second body part.

The face/back pair can therefore function as an exposure mechanism that collapses a public presentation and its concealed contrary alignment.

Downstream prose should call it an exploratory imprinting model, not claim literal branding or lexical identity between the roots.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the noun for angels does not itself assert ownership or kingship in the sentence. Downstream prose should frame it as a latent custody-transfer model, not as an etymological proof or replacement for death-taking.

strongest_changes: The adjacent d-b-r sequence turns the struck back into the embodied consequence of a prior informed retreat.
Known secrecy, extraction of what is inward, and recognition by marks revise the face/back pair into a forced disclosure of divided allegiance.
Completion, testing, reports, repeated actions, and non-diminution make death read as closure of a complete evidentiary account.
Earlier representational and physical uses of striking allow the angelic blow to remain literal while carrying a secondary exemplary function.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sits at a dense crossing of backward-motion recurrence, concealed-versus-visible structure, terminal arrival, and calibrated striking. That crossing supports several coexisting readings without reducing the bodily death scene to metaphor.
remaining_uncertainties: The syntax strongly secures literal angelic striking but does not itself state the causal arrows from reversal, secrecy, or failed perception.
Face and back may be a totalizing bodily pair without carrying social, temporal, or evidentiary poles in every rendering.
The imprint and custody-transfer outliers depend on deliberately branch-distant material analogies and require explicit exploratory qualification.
